product_overview: FotoClic is an online marketplace for sports and event photography that connects photographers with customers looking for their event photos. The platform supports event and photo discovery, facial search, shopping cart checkout, and separate dashboards for photographers, customers, and administrators.
core_goals: Help customers find their photos quickly through search, event browsing, and facial recognition.
Enable customers to purchase selected photos through a simple checkout flow.
Give photographers tools to create events, upload photos, track earnings, and manage payouts.
Provide administrators with a control panel to review photographer approvals and monitor platform activity.

features.name: User Login & Logout
features.description: Allows registered customers, photographers, and administrators to sign in to their account from the login page.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit the login form -> See the appropriate account area

features.name: User Registration
features.description: Lets new users create an account as either a customer or a photographer.
user_flows: Navigate to /cadastro -> Fill in full name -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Select an account role -> Submit the registration form -> See confirmation or next-step status

features.name: Photo Search & Discovery
features.description: Allows visitors to search for photos using text, browse search results, or use an image for facial matching.
user_flows: Navigate to /encontrar-fotos -> Enter a search query -> Start the search -> See matching photos and events
Navigate to /encontrar-fotos -> Upload an image for face search -> Start the search -> See photos that match the uploaded face

features.name: Shopping Cart Management
features.description: Lets visitors add selected photos to a cart, review items, and remove photos they no longer want to buy.
user_flows: Open a photo preview -> Add the photo to the cart -> Navigate to /carrinho -> Review selected items in the cart
Navigate to /carrinho -> Remove an item from the cart -> See the updated cart contents

features.name: Checkout & Payment Process
features.description: Allows authenticated customers to apply a coupon and complete payment through the PIX checkout flow.
user_flows: Navigate to /checkout -> Fill in a coupon code -> Apply the coupon -> Review the updated order total -> Proceed with checkout -> See the payment confirmation page
Navigate to /checkout -> Review the order details -> Proceed with checkout -> See the PIX payment step and completion confirmation

features.name: Photographer Panel Dashboard
features.description: Gives photographers tools to create events, upload images, view wallet balances, and request payouts.
user_flows: Navigate to /area-fotografo -> Create a new event -> Fill in the event details -> Submit the event form -> See the new event in the dashboard
Navigate to /area-fotografo -> Select an event -> Upload images for that event -> See the uploaded photos associated with the event
Navigate to /area-fotografo -> Open the wallet section -> Review balances -> Request a payout -> See the payout request recorded

features.name: Administrative Management Dashboard
features.description: Provides administrators with controls to review pending photographer accounts, approve or reject requests, and inspect platform summaries.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> Open the pending photographers section -> Review a photographer request -> Approve the request -> See the updated approval status
Navigate to /admin -> Open the pending photographers section -> Review a photographer request -> Reject the request -> See the updated rejection status
Navigate to /admin -> View global financial summaries -> Review platform logs -> See the current operational overview
